edits.old:
A Detailed and Accurate 3D Representation of the Contiguous 48 U.S. States

This Contiguous 48 USA States 3D Model is designed for high-quality visualization, educational projects, and creative applications. Whether you are an educator, designer, or developer, this model provides a realistic and interactive representation of the United States.
edits.text:
48 contiguous states in C4D and OBJ

Explore the terrain of the 48 contiguous United States with separate state meshes supplied in C4D and OBJ. The collection includes TIF maps for building terrain visualizations, educational scenes and presentations.

edits.old:
Key Features of the Model

✔️ Low-Polygon Mesh for Optimal Performance

Each of the 48 states is carefully designed with a low-polygon structure, ensuring smooth rendering and easy integration into various applications.

✔️ High-Resolution Textures for Maximum Realism

The model includes multiple texture sets to enhance its usability and realism:

  • Satellite Texture – Provides real-world imagery for authentic geographic representation.

  • Pseudocolor Elevation Texture – Highlights terrain features where colors change based on elevation levels.

  • Water Body Map – Clearly marks lakes, rivers, and coastlines for precise mapping.

  • Normal Map (From High-Resolution Model) – Adds fine details by simulating high-resolution terrain on a low-poly mesh.

  • UV Map (frontal projection)

✔️ Seamless Integration with 3D Applications

This 3D geography model is compatible with various rendering engines and creative software. Whether used for interactive maps, 3D visualization, or game environments, it ensures a smooth and accurate representation of the United States.
edits.text:
Formats and terrain maps

The package lists 48 polygonal state meshes with closed bases. The model uses a Lambert Conformal Conic projection and a vertical scale factor of 3. The specification lists 11,586,716 polygons in total; performance depends on your software, hardware and scene settings.

The listed TIF maps include satellite, pseudo-color elevation, water and normal maps, with frontal UV mapping. Check the file specifications above for package sizes and format details.

edits.old:
Why Choose This 3D Model?

✅ Optimized for High-Quality Renders – With normal maps from a high-resolution source, the model achieves exceptional detail in topographic features.
✅ Perfect for Educational and Professional Use – A must-have for teachers, researchers, and designers working on U.S. geography projects.
✅ Multiple Formats Available – Compatible with Blender, 3ds Max, Unity, Unreal Engine, and more.
✅ Customizable & Ready for Modifications – Can be used as is or edited to fit specific project needs.

Ideal Use Cases

  • Educational Tools – Perfect for schools and universities to teach geography interactively.

  • Game & VR Development – Create realistic U.S. landscapes for immersive experiences.

  • Architectural & Urban Planning – Utilize for topographic analysis and city planning.

  • Media & Film Production – High-quality renders suitable for documentaries and simulations.
edits.text:
Using the collection

Use the models as assets in a 3D workflow that supports the supplied C4D or OBJ files. Import behavior, materials and performance depend on the application and version. The closed bases do not by themselves establish print or CNC readiness: inspect and prepare the geometry for your equipment, material and scale.

The contiguous collection excludes Alaska and Hawaii. For a separate collection covering all 50 states, see the existing 50-state product link below; its supplied formats and base differ.
